semantics.clock: Update Q on each positive clk edge, as explicitly stated by the Qold definition.
semantics.between_edges: Retain Q between positive clock edges.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified; none is added.
semantics.initialization: No initial Q value is specified; no initialization is added. Simulation Q is initially unknown until a set or clear edge.

numeric.width: All ports and stored state are one bit

verification.oracle: Original JK truth table applied to independently tracked pre-edge state
verification.sampling: Check retention before edges and on falling edges; sample updates after the positive-edge nonblocking assignment phase
verification.cases: Initial unknown hold/toggle, clear and set recovery, all four input combinations from both known states, repeated toggle and hold, input changes without positive edges
verification.completion: Bounded timeout, fatal mismatches, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up Q is unspecified; RTL has no initialization, and development checks use four-state simulation unknown before the first set or clear.
Behavior for unknown or high-impedance j/k inputs is unspecified; functional checks use binary j/k.
